description: Compiles a workspace into an immutable Container Version (the unit that gets published). SIDE EFFECT: the source workspace is DELETED and replaced by a fresh one — the response's newWorkspacePath points to the replacement; use it for any further edits, or old workspace paths will 404. Returns { containerVersion (with containerVersionId and full tag/trigger/variable snapshots), syncStatus, newWorkspacePath }. A compile failure comes back as compilerError=true with HTTP 200 and is reported as an error. Requires the tagmanager.edit.containerversions scope (edit.containers is NOT sufficient).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (string) to compile. This workspace is deleted afterwards.

name: create_version
title: Create a container version from a workspace
